The most deliberate thing on the chart is the WATCH band painted across the JOIN at 3,417-3,457, where the weekly ladder begins and the base ladder's 1.414 lands. Beneath the base ladder's own swing high (3,041.30) the map thins fast -- an 11.8% void under 2,885 -- until its foot at 2,037, which he pinned with two separate bands from above and below.
